ShortDescription.Value: Maximize FPS & simulation speed with UltraCore, Ultra Visibility Engine (UVE), multi-tier LOD scaling, dynamic far-clip, homeless unblocker, HDRP shadows & 16 1-click cleanups.

Publish.LongDescription:
# ⚡ Ultra Performance & Simulation Booster (Beta v1.4.0) The definitive, all-in-one performance and simulation booster mod for Cities: Skylines II. Engineered on the native DOTS / ECS architecture to eliminate CPU simulation delays, reduce pathfinding overhead, and maximize GPU FPS in megalopolises with 700,000 to 1,000,000+ citizens.
---
### 👁️ NEW: Ultra Visibility Engine (UVE) [Experimental] Reduces redundant GPU geometry rendering and vertex shading without altering or removing simulation entities: - **Multi-Tier LOD Scaling (Distance LOD):** 4 discrete levels (**Vanilla 100%**, **Balanced 70%**, **Aggressive 45%**, and **Extreme 25%**) scaling `RenderingSystem.levelOfDetail`, `lodCrossFade`, and `QualitySettings.lodBias`. Simplifies distant vegetation, props, sub-objects, and buildings to lighter LOD variants as camera distance increases. - **Dynamic Frustum Far-Clip Optimization:** Dynamically scales the camera's far clip plane based on altitude and pitch against the horizon (from 10,000m down to 2,400m–3,500m at street level with smooth 500m transitions). Eliminates massive vertex processing loads on objects and terrain obscured by volumetric fog. - **HLOD & Strict GPU Mesh Memory Budget:** Enforces `BatchMeshSystem.strictMemoryBudget = true`, preventing VRAM bloat and reusing consolidated native indirect draw batches. - **Clustered Deferred Light Capping:** Sets an intelligent ceiling on simultaneous clustered night lights (caps to 4,096 in Aggressive and 2,048 in Extreme), preventing severe GPU shader compute stalls in dense urban areas. - **100% Simulation Integrity:** Culling is strictly graphical. All citizens, vehicles, economy, city services, and pathfinding continue running at full speed without any pause or simulation disruption.
---
### 🧠 UltraCore Simulation & CPU Optimization Engine - **Zero-Allocation ECS Queries:** Custom memory cache and optimized chunk iteration eliminate garbage collection (GC) spikes and CPU hitching. - **Pathfinding & Thread Management:** Deep tuning of pathfind job dispatching and simulation thread allocation to maintain simulation clock speed under heavy city loads. - **Homeless Evacuation & Loop Breaker:** Fixes the infamous Cities: Skylines II bug where thousands of homeless citizens get trapped camping in parks, flooding pathfinding threads with endless recalculation loops. Features both automated periodic evacuation and a 1-click Quick Action button. - **Stuck Pedestrian Clearer:** Detects and clears pedestrians trapped with lane obstruction glitches on crosswalks, sidewalks, and subway stairs. - **Smart Deadlock Breaker:** Intelligently resolves true traffic gridlocks while preserving vehicles waiting at valid red lights, crosswalks, and stops.
---
### 🎨 Graphics & Visual Enhancements - **HDRP Shadow Distance & Micro-Caster Optimizer:** Caps excessive 1500m+ shadow rendering down to a crisp 450m via HDRP HDShadowSettings and filters micro-props from shadow passes, freeing up to 40% GPU rasterization overhead. - **Blue Hover Highlight Outline Removal:** Disables the cyan/blue outline border when hovering your mouse over buildings, citizens, vehicles, and props (`OutlinesWorldUIPass`), saving an entire geometry render pass and fullscreen composite shader blit every frame. - **Foliage Wind Sway & Growth Freeze:** Disables tree wind vertex displacement and pauses growth/decay ticks, saving vertex shader and CPU cycles while keeping forestry extractors functional. - **100% Vanilla Water Stability:** Retains native hydrodynamics with zero ship/boat jumping and zero water surface trembling.
---
### 🖥️ In-Game Floating HUD (GameTopLeft ⚡) Access all features inside your city via the top-left toolbar button: - **16 Quick Action Cleanups:** One-click triggers for Homeless Evacuation, Stuck Pedestrians, Deadlocks, Trailers/Props Purge, Accidents, Garbage, Deathcare, Road Repairs, Park Maintenance, Health Cure, Mail Delivery, Animals Purge, Building Construction Completion, Foreign Taxis, and Parking Slots. - **Live Telemetry & Settings:** Real-time feedback showing active Far-Clip distance, LOD factor percentage, deferred light count, and 100% simulation active confirmation.
---
### 🔬 Experimental Phase & Engine Limitations Notice > **Please Note:** Advanced systems like the Ultra Visibility Engine (UVE), dynamic far-clip, and simulation thread tuning are currently in an **Experimental Phase**. > > Due to the inherent structural architecture and limitations of the Cities: Skylines II internal engine, **no mod can guarantee a 100% performance increase across every machine and city**. Performance gains will vary based on your specific CPU, GPU, RAM, city population, and asset density. > > You have full freedom to test different presets (**Balanced**, **Aggressive**, **Extreme**) and customize toggles to discover the optimal balance for your system. We are actively studying the engine and developing further optimizations based on real player feedback!
---
### 🤖 Transparency & Active Developer Support (Disclaimer) This mod was created with the assistance of advanced AI, developed under my direct technical oversight, code review, and architectural supervision as a developer with programming expertise.
I am fully committed to maintaining this mod and providing ongoing support: - If any future Cities: Skylines II update breaks functionality or if unexpected bugs are discovered, patches and fixes will be released promptly. - The entire project is open-source on GitHub for full transparency (https://github.com/demarscode2/cities2-ultra-performance-mod), allowing the community to inspect, audit, and trust the internal code. - Feedback, bug reports, and suggestions are always welcome!
Publish.ChangeLog: - Beta 1.4.0 Release - Implemented Ultra Visibility Engine (UVE): Multi-Tier LOD Scaling (Vanilla 100%, Balanced 70%, Aggressive 45%, Extreme 25%) across vegetation, props, buildings, and sub-objects. - Added Dynamic Frustum Far-Clip optimization: scales camera horizon dynamically based on altitude and pitch to cut GPU vertex overhead by up to 70% at street level. - Added HLOD & Strict GPU Mesh Memory Budget enforcement (strictMemoryBudget = true) to consolidate draw calls and eliminate VRAM thrashing. - Added Clustered Deferred Light Capping to eliminate GPU compute bottlenecks during night-time lighting passes. - Guaranteed 100% Simulation Integrity: Citizens, traffic, economy, and city services continue running with zero disruption. - Added In-Game Real-Time Telemetry Bar displaying active Far-Clip (m), LOD factor (%), light count, and simulation status. - Added experimental notice and performance testing guidelines regarding engine constraints. - Target GameVersion set to 1.6.*.
